buster-1.0.0-docker-build:
  ARG TARGETPLATFORM
  ARG BUILD_DATE
  ARG DISTRO_NAME
  ARG FOO_BAR_VERSION
  ARG NODEJS_VERSION

  FROM DOCKERFILE -f foo/Dockerfile --build-arg BUILD_DATE="$BUILD_DATE" --build-arg DISTRO_NAME="$DISTRO_NAME" --build-arg FOO_BAR_VERSION="$FOO_BAR_VERSION" --build-arg NODEJS_VERSION="$NODEJS_VERSION" --platform "$TARGETPLATFORM" .
  SAVE IMAGE --cache-hint foo-bar/"$FOO_BAR_VERSION"/"$DISTRO_NAME":"$BUILD_DATE"

buster-1.0.0-docker-push:
  ARG TARGETPLATFORM
  ARG BUILD_DATE
  ARG DISTRO_NAME
  ARG FOO_BAR_VERSION
  ARG NODEJS_VERSION

  FROM --platform "$TARGETPLATFORM" +buster-1.0.0-docker-build
  SAVE IMAGE --push registry.example.net/images/base/foo-bar:1.0.0 registry.example.net/images/base/foo-bar:1.0.0-buster registry.example.net/images/base/foo-bar:latest

  BUILD --platform "linux/amd64" +buster-1.0.0-docker-build

buster-1.0.0-push:
  BUILD --platform "linux/amd64" +buster-1.0.0-docker-push
